title: 5 quart shoe storage boxes 10 pk
text:
5 quart shoe storage boxes 10 pk. UPDATE below....I purchased similar of these with purple handles and they seem to be a bit better - stronger in closing.. these are not quite as sturdy; but do work. I purchased them to store shoes... I wear a size 9 (womens) shoe and this fit all my shoes and even one pair of ankle boots I own. They are clear plastic boxes and lids with black handles. I prefer the handle closers as the shoe boxes that you just press down sometimes don't close or stay closed. So if you want a box that will stay closed, the handle closures are a better chose in my opinion. You get 10 boxes and lids in this set and I believe it is a comparable price to what is available locally for me but Amazon delivers to your door, thus saving you gas too. I always recommend checking your local pricing if dollars are the most important thing to you.
I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I really hope this info was helpful to you. If not, please let me know in the comment section what info you like to see.
UPDATE: 2/18/2019... purchased a second set... two of the lids were broken - the shipping box was in perfect condition, so it would appear they went into the box broken... but then are pretty brittle plastic, I wouldn't take too much to break them. The bottoms were all fine. The lids may be a bit more fragile. Of course, Amazon made this right.
